issues.description: Numeric threshold mismatch for Aufgabe 06: problem_statement.md (line 133) requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants ("mehr als 100.000 männliche und mehr als 100.000 weibliche"), but solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql (line 3) uses WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000 (10,000). This discrepancy yields different result sets and will confuse students which threshold to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the threshold consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql line 3 to use the 100,000 threshold: WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000. Also ensure any automated tests and the template (or task text) reference the same threshold. Alternatively, if 10,000 was intended, update problem_statement.md line 133 to state 10.000 and adjust tests and solution accordingly.
